title: Stop Saying "Very Crazy"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very crazy". Use one of these words instead:
• Insane (informal): an insane idea
• Wild: a wild party
• Absurd: an absurd plan
• Ridiculous: a ridiculous price
• Outrageous: an outrageous demand

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
